description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.
At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.
Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
About the role
Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.
The Data Production Engineering team is an SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team responsible for the overall ownership of 3rd party data services at Netskope. Including relational databases, noSQL datastores, data caching and streaming services, etc… The team designs, implements, automates, maintains, monitors, and manages these platforms. The team consists of Data Systems Architects and Data SREs.
What’s in it for you
As a Lead Data SRE on the DPE team, you will participate in strategic architectural direction and lead the implementation, operation, performance tuning, and scaling of Netskope’s production data services. In addition, you will provide overarching technical leadership for the team, and mentor senior and junior team members.
Essential Functions
Serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical lead for designated DPE platforms, storage systems, and infrastructure automation tools.
Working closely with DPE architects and Product Engineering leads to architect, scale, and improve the overall reliability, efficiency, and performance of DPE platforms.
Designing, building, and maintaining software tools and automation using a variety of programming languages including Python, Go, and Bash at a senior/staff level.
Establishing and driving organization-wide adoption of SOPs, engineering standards, and procedural documentation.
Leading cross-functional technical evaluations, POCs, and integration of next-generation data platforms and tooling.
Applying a deep understanding of non-functional requirements (scalability, disaster recovery, high availability, latency, throughput) to shape platform architecture and ensure business requirements are met.
Embracing our corporate culture by fostering collaboration without boundaries, and encouraging teamwork and communication that is clear, open, and honest.
Required skills and experience
Please note that due to the specific requirements of working within a FedRAMP High certified environment, all candidates for this position must be U.S. citizens currently residing within the United States.
5+ years of general Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering experience.
8+ years of experience with large-scale, high-throughput, distributed clustered data system environments.
8+ years of experience with deep troubleshooting, kernel/system performance tuning, and configuration of Linux systems.
Hands-on experience building tools and automating repetitive tasks with Python and Bash
Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional remote teams.
Participate in an on-call rotation to provide tier-3 technical escalation support for critical systems in emergency situations.
Demonstrated ability to track industry trends, evaluate emerging data technologies, and provide data-driven technical roadmaps and strategic recommendations.
Actively mentor senior and junior team members, foster technical growth, and share best practices across the engineering organization.
Desired Experience
Demonstrated staff-level depth of knowledge in one or more Database platforms listed:
Relational DB: MariaDB, PostgreSQL, YugabyteDB, ClickhouseDB
NoSQL: MongoDB, ScyllaDB
Messaging: Pulsar, Kafka
Caching: Redis, ValKey
Deep operational experience with telemetry, monitoring, capacity planning, and automation tooling such as: Jenkins, Salt, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Jira, Confluence.
Proficiency in a variety of programming languages including Python, Go, C, and C++.
Extensive knowledge of cloud and container infrastructure technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, KVM, OpenStack, or orchestration platforms).
Education
BSCS, EE, IT, or equivalent technical degree preferred
Compensation:
At Netskope, salary is one component of our competitive total rewards package. The salary range for this position is as listed below. This is a national range. For purposes of complying with applicable laws, the range applies to candidates in California, Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, New York, Washington, and other states.
The successful candidate’s starting pay will also be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, and market conditions.
For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the On Target Earnings (OTE) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target commission amount at 100% goal achievement.
In addition to salary, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus plan (for non-sales roles) and a stock award program. Candidates may also be eligible for a comprehensive health plan and other benefits that can be reviewed at Netskope Benefits site.
Salary Range
$89,000—$180,000 USD
Netskope is committed to implementing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. Netskope does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on religion, race, color, sex, marital or veteran statues, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, genetic information, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations of any jurisdiction in which we operate.
Netskope respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us, please refer to Netskope's Privacy Policy for more details.
